service.name: Another Aloalo Island
service.longDescription: Inspired by your tale, Osmon rejoices as his imagination soars to heights untold. Visions of the glorious civilizations the peoples of Aloalo built take shape in his mind, populating the island with beasts imbued by esoteric magicks. Drawn into this tide of fantasy and swept to its remotest edge, you must now do battle with the mundane made legendary.
